listen_to.description: Address dictd binds to (listen_to in the global section). The package binds to localhost only.

port.description: TCP port dictd listens on (port in the global section). Unset = the built-in 2628.

delay.description: Idle timeout in seconds before a client is disconnected (delay in the global section). Unset = no limit.

allow.description: Hosts/networks allowed to connect, one allow line each: a host name, an IP, a pattern such as 192.168.1.*, or inetd for connections handed over by the inetd server.

deny.description: Hosts/networks refused even when an allow entry matches, one deny line each (same forms as allow).

dictionaries.description: Extra databases beyond /var/lib/dictd/db.list, one database block each: name, datafile and index are required; short_name and desc are optional.
